text: Notched up 4 wins in 2025 (at up to 13f) but she's essentially looked summed up by her handicap mark more recently, no extra last ½f when fifth of 6 at Nottingham (1¾m, good) 52 days ago. Steps back down in trip now.

Found improvement when winning 8-runner handicap at Redcar (5f, good to firm) 23 days ago. Raced from 2 lb out of the handicap on that occasion, so 3 lb rise looks more than fair and ought to go well again.
Opened hurdles account at the ninth attempt at Ludlow (2m) in November. Not disgraced when third at Sedgefield (17f) after and arrives fit from the Flat so can't be discounted.

Winner on the Flat for Ed Walker but rather temperamental. Encouraging hurdles debut fourth at Huntingdon but failed to build on it when a well-held fourth in 2m Southwell novice later in November. Returns after a breathing operation now.

Winner of Buckingham Palace Stakes here in 2023 and proved he's still capable of running to a smart level when successful at Newcastle in January. Hasn't been in the same form since, though, finishing well held at Newbury a month ago.

Winner at Sandown (5f) last summer for Michael Appleby and went close over the same C&D on stable debut. However, he's been well below form in 3 outings this year and for all he drops in grade here, he has enough to prove at present.

Failed to win in a 10-race hurdle career but came good at the first of asking over fences in 3-runner novice handicap at Cartmel (21f, good) 3 weeks ago. Not entirely straightforward but has the ability to rate higher in this sphere.
Ended the 2024/25 season badly out of sorts and offered little on his recent comeback at this course.
Foaled January 26. €18,000 Shaman filly. Half-sister to 6f winner Farandaway. Dam 6f winner. Worth a second look in the betting on debut.
Fair maiden on the Flat. Built on hurdling debut with third of 7 in novice hurdle at Southwell (2m) 37 days ago. May do better still.
Only fifth when 6/5 for her Newmarket debut but showed why she was a short price that day with a win at Yarmouth (5f, good) 5 weeks later. Will go on improving.
7/2 and hooded, shaped as if in need of the run when fifth of 8 in novice over C&D on debut 6 days ago. In very good hands and can build on it here.

Progressive as a 2-y-o, twice a runner up before posting very good fifth in Newmarket's Zetland Stakes in October. Reappeared with an all-the-way win in 4-runner novice at Redcar (1¼m) and ran well back up in grade in Chester Vase and has got the physical scope for further progress. Tongue strap on.

Smart performer at his best, recording a hat-trick at Jebel Ali in 2023/24. However, after 15-month absence he was a long way below that level in 2 starts in February, seventh of 11 in Group 3 at Meydan when last seen.
Much improved to make a winning handicap debut at Hereford (2m, good to soft) in March, forging clear. Took a heavy fall at Exeter next time but has been given plenty of time to get over that.
11/1, shaped as if needing the run when fading into a remote fifth on Warwick bumper debut in February. More is needed now hurdling.

Looked good prospect when winning 1m novices at Windsor and Newmarket first 2 starts. Hasn't kicked on since, too free when down the field in 7f conditions race at Thirsk on return, but he's well worth another chance on handicap debut having had a breathing operation with tongue strap back on.

Enjoyed a productive campaign at 3 yrs, his 4 wins including a valuable event at York, and with reappearance run behind him proved at least as good as ever when ½-length second of 12 to Erzindjan at Newmarket (9f) last month.

Won twice last year but out of sorts this spring, beating one over C&D last time out. Has slipped below his last winning mark though so can't be dismissed, especially if the market speaks in his favour.
Well backed when making a winning start to her career in 9-runner novice at Salisbury (5f, good to soft, 3/1) 25 days ago. Yet another in this line-up who is open to progress.
